# InvestmentCalculator

Figma: [08a. InvestmentCalculator](https://www.figma.com/design/a7Z956YZy9n6f9uz5DK16Y?node-id=69-953) · Family: 08 Safqah-Specific · Status: stable · Version 2.0.0 · Updated 2026-01-01

An interactive estimator: the user picks an amount and duration, and the calculator shows expected ROI, gross/net profit, a payout schedule, promo entry and checkout. Composed from Investment-amount, Distribution-schedule, Promo-code, Checkout and Payment-details, with ROI/Gross/Net atoms. RTL.

Reference image (every variant, labelled): `knowledge/examples/components/investment-calculator/reference.png`

### Promo-code

Promo-code entry row in the invest flow: a grey «إضافة رمز ترويجي» add row, or once applied a green chip with the code, the discount it gives (for example 50% off the investment agency fee) and a remove ×.

Level: molecule · Part of: Investment Calculator

Use when:
- Letting an investor add a promo code before checkout in the Investment Calculator flow
- Showing an applied code and its fee discount with a way to remove it

Don't use when:
- For generic text entry use Input
- For a static discount label use Tag

Accessibility: The remove × needs an accessible name such as «إزالة الرمز الترويجي»; announce the discount when a code is applied.

Compliance: State the discount exactly as the offer applies (it reduces the agency fee on profit), never as a boost to the return rate.

| Property in Figma | Code name | Type | Values | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Has Headling | `hasHeadling` | boolean |  | true |
| State | `state` | variant | Added, Not-added | Added |
| Direction | `direction` | variant | LTR, RTL | RTL |

### Distribution-schedule

Collapsible payout schedule for the legacy calculator: a «جدول التوزيعات» header with a count and toggle that opens a list of expected distribution dates and amounts, or a single «توزيع الأرباح: نهاية المدة» line when profit is paid at maturity.

Level: molecule · Part of: Investment Calculator, Calculator / Results card

Use when:
- Showing the expected payout dates and amounts before an investor commits
- Showing a single end-of-term payout with Property 1=No-Schedule
- As the footer of Calculator / Results card (No-Schedule)

Don't use when:
- For actual paid or late distributions after investing use Payouts cell
- For the Calculator v2 amount step use Calculator / Distributions accordion
- For the deal lifecycle use DealTimeline

Accessibility: The toggle is a button with expanded/collapsed state; read each row as date then amount.

Compliance: Dates are expected: keep the line «تحدد التواريخ الدقيقة بعد إكتمال عملية التمويل» and mark amounts as projected.

| Property in Figma | Code name | Type | Values | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Property 1 | `unnamed1` | variant | Full list, Less-list, No-Schedule | Full list |
| Direction | `direction` | variant | LTR, RTL | RTL |

### Checkout

Payment-method picker at the end of the invest flow: three tiles (bank transfer, payment card, Apple Pay) with one selected and a «أفضل خيار» badge; card selection reveals card number, expiry and CVV fields.

Level: molecule · Contains: Input · Part of: Investment Calculator

Use when:
- Choosing how to pay for an investment after the amount is set
- Showing card fields only when Method=Credit-card

Don't use when:
- For non-payment single choice use Radio Group or SegmentedTabs
- For a wallet balance deduction summary use Payment-details

Accessibility: Tiles behave as a radiogroup with one checked tile; card fields need visible labels, not placeholder-only.

Compliance: Show any method fee before confirmation; the «أفضل خيار» badge must reflect a real cost or speed advantage, not a nudge.

| Property in Figma | Code name | Type | Values | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Method | `method` | variant | ApplePay, Bank-transfer, Credit-card | Bank-transfer |
| Direction | `direction` | variant | LTR, RTL | RTL |

### Investment-amount

The amount block of the legacy calculator: big editable riyal amount, then a breakdown of return on investment, gross profit, investment agency fee (incl. 15% VAT), optional fee discount from a promo, and net profit. Variants cover regular, qualified and read-only users.

Level: molecule · Contains: _ROI, _Gross-profit, _Net-profit, Calculator-list-item · Part of: Investment Calculator

Use when:
- Showing the profit breakdown for the amount an investor typed
- Reflecting an applied promo with Promo=Adedd (discounted agency fee)
- Read-only summary with User=Without-edit

Don't use when:
- For the Calculator v2 flow use Calculator / Amount card and Calculator / Results card
- For a single label-value pair use KeyValue

Accessibility: The edit pencil needs a label («تعديل المبلغ»); announce net profit when the amount changes.

Compliance: Figures are projections: label them expected (متوقع), show net after the agency fee (1% of profit, never of capital) beside gross, and never imply a guaranteed return. The agency fee line includes 15% VAT; keep that hint.

| Property in Figma | Code name | Type | Values | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Has Content | `hasContent` | boolean |  | true |
| User | `user` | variant | Regular, Qualifide, Without-edit | Regular |
| Promo | `promo` | variant | Not-adedd, No-PROMO, Adedd | Not-adedd |
| Direction | `direction` | variant | LTR, RTL | RTL |

### Payment-details

Payment summary rows before paying: total amount, wallet balance deducted (green), and the remaining amount to pay.

Level: molecule · Part of: Investment Calculator

Use when:
- Before checkout when part of the investment is paid from the Safqah wallet
- Showing exactly what is left to pay by the chosen method

Don't use when:
- For profit breakdowns use Investment-amount
- For generic label-value rows use KeyValue

Accessibility: Read rows as label then amount; the remaining total is the last, emphasised row.

Compliance: Never hide the total to pay: amount, wallet deduction and remaining amount must all be visible before confirming.

_No properties._

### Investment Calculator

Legacy deal-page calculator organism: expected return headline, gross/net breakdown and distribution schedule, then step 1 pick the term and annual return (closed terms marked fully funded), and step 2 set the amount on a slider (retail range 1,000 to 20,000) or by typing for qualified investors.

Level: organism · Contains: Investment-amount, Distribution-schedule, Promo-code, Checkout, Payment-details, _ROI, _Gross-profit, _Net-profit

Use when:
- On a deal's invest flow when a retail investor models amount and term
- Qualified investors with Value=Qualified-user (typed amount, no 20,000 cap)
- Showing the upgrade prompt to qualified status for amounts above 20,000

Don't use when:
- For the newer qualified deal-page flow use Calculator / Duration picker, Calculator / Amount card and Calculator / Results card
- For a full-screen keypad entry use QualifiedCalculator or Keypad / Amount input

Accessibility: Keep slider and amount text in sync; the slider needs a label and min/max values announced.

Compliance: Figures are projections: label them expected (متوقع), show net after the agency fee (1% of profit, never of capital) beside gross, and never imply a guaranteed return. The upgrade prompt must not promise returns, only higher limits.

| Property in Figma | Code name | Type | Values | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Value | `value` | variant | 1, 4, 20, Qualified-user | 20 |
| Direction | `direction` | variant | LTR, RTL | RTL |

### Calculator / Info label

Muted metric label with a trailing info icon (for example «نسبة العائد السنوي ⓘ», «إجمالي الربح ⓘ»), used for every metric name in Calculator v2.

Level: atom · Part of: Calculator / Stat tile, Calculator / Metric row

Use when:
- Labelling a metric in Calculator / Stat tile or Calculator / Metric row
- When the metric needs a one-tap explanation

Don't use when:
- For field labels in forms use Form Field Label
- For a free-floating explanation bubble use Tooltip

Accessibility: The info icon needs a label naming the metric it explains and a 44 px tap target.

Compliance: Arabic labels for a % return start with «نسبة» (نسبة صافي العائد).

## Guide from the doc page

### Overview

InvestmentCalculator lets an investor model a deal before committing - enter an amount, pick a duration, and see the expected return, profit breakdown, payout schedule, and the checkout path. Use it on a deal’s invest flow. It’s an organism composed of smaller, independently usable parts.

### Anatomy

One calculator = Investment-amount (amount + live ROI/gross/net breakdown) → duration chips → Distribution-schedule (payouts) → Promo-code → Checkout → Payment-details. ROI/Gross/Net are the figure atoms.

Investment Calculator

### States

Example states by invested amount, plus the qualified-investor state (different limits/returns).

1,000

20,000

Qualified investor

### Parts

Each part is usable on its own: Investment-amount, Distribution-schedule, Promo-code, Checkout, Payment-details.

Investment-amount

Distribution-schedule

Promo-code

Checkout

Payment-details

### Atoms

The figure atoms - ROI %, gross profit, net profit - recompute live from the amount and recur across the parts.

_ROI

_Gross-profit

_Net-profit

### Code examples

Flutter - state drives the live figures.

```dart
InvestmentCalculator(
  deal: deal,
  amount: amount,            // bound to slider + input
  durationMonths: duration,  // 3 / 6 / 16…
  promo: appliedPromo,
  qualified: user.isQualified,
  onChanged: (amount, duration) => recompute(),
  // derived: roi, grossProfit, netProfit, schedule
  onCheckout: (method) => startCheckout(method),
)
```

### Usage - Do & Don’t

Do

Recompute and show ROI / gross / net live as the amount and duration change.

Don’t

Don’t present projected returns as guaranteed - label them “expected” with the assumptions + disclaimer.

Do

Keep slider and input in sync, and surface the payout schedule before checkout.

Don’t

Don’t bury the total-to-pay - Payment-details should summarise amount, fees and total clearly.

- Investment Calculator
- Investment-amount

- Promo-code
- Checkout
- Payment-details
- _ROI
- _Gross-profit
- _Net-profit

### Overview

Calculator v2 lets a qualified investor model a deal on the deal page. Step 1 picks the term and its annual rate, step 2 sets the amount and shows the payout plan, step 3 shows what they receive after fees.

### Anatomy

Three organisms stacked in order. Each is a separate component so screens can reorder steps without detaching.

Duration picker

Amount card

Results card

### States

Every state is a variant. Accordions use On click → Change to with Smart animate.

### Duration picker · Position

First · start arrow disabled

Middle

Last · end arrow disabled

### Amount card · Distributions

Closed

Open

### Results card · Indicators

Closed

Open

### Direction

RTL is the default. LTR mirrors order, alignment and arrows, and translates copy. Numbers stay Western in both.

RTL

LTR

### Molecules

Built only from the atoms below and existing Syntropy components.

Metric row

Stat strip

Duration carousel

Amount display

Installment row

Distributions header

Distributions accordion

### Atoms

The smallest calculator-specific parts.

Info label

Stat tile

Duration option

Swipe arrow

Funded label

Disclosure toggle

Date tile

### Reused from Syntropy

- MoneyAmount · every riyal amount, with the riyal icon (sm in rows, lg brand for the total received).
- IconButton · tertiary, lg, opens the amount keypad.
- Divider · horizontal in the amount card, vertical inside the stat strip.
- Distribution-schedule · No-Schedule footer of the results card.
- Icons · Help (12), Arrow-left 2, Arrow-right 3, arrow-left, calendar.

### Tokens

No raw values. Colour, radius, spacing and type all come from Semantic variables and text styles.

- Colour · text/default, text/muted, text/success, icon/default, icon/muted, bg/surface, bg/success-subtle, border/subtle, border/default.
- Radius · radius/sm (date tile), radius/md (cards, strip, rows), radius/full (icon box).
- Spacing · space/2xs, xs, sm, md, lg for every gap and padding.
- Type · body/14/semibold (headings), body/16/semibold (stat values), body/13 (rows), caption/12, caption/11, caption/10, caption/9.

### Content rules

- Green is for profit only: total received, ROI, payout day. Duration and annual rate stay neutral.
- Agency fee is 1% of profit, never of capital. Example 100,000 for 16 months at 16%: profit 21,333, fee 213, net 21,120, received 121,120.
- Show the riyal icon, not the word ريال. Numbers are Western in both directions.
- Keep percentages in their own text node so the % never flips in Arabic.

### Accessibility

- Swipe arrows are 20 px visually; give them a 44 px tap target in code.
- Info icons need a label naming the metric they explain.
- Closed terms are announced as closed and cannot be selected.
- Disabled arrows at the first and last term are not focusable.

> **Tip:** Announce the new rate and total when the term changes, so screen-reader users hear the effect of a swipe.

### Code examples

Flutter usage for the results card.

```dart
CalculatorResultsCard(
  received: 121120,
  durationMonths: 16,
  annualRate: 16.00,
  netReturn: 21.12,
  grossProfit: 21333,
  netProfit: 21120,
  irr: 15.45,
  fee: 213,               // 1% of profit
  indicatorsOpen: false,
  textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
)
```

### Usage · Do & Don’t

Do

Keep green for profit values only: total received and ROI.

Don’t

Don’t colour duration or annual rate green. They are not profit.

Do

Disable the arrow at the first and last term so the end of the list is clear.

Don’t

Don’t show the agency fee as a share of capital. It is 1% of profit.
